title: Borrowed Credentials
description: A driver's access token should never open an admin's doors, no matter how the request is dressed up. Stress the admin-only example route with every non-admin role to confirm none of them slip through.
successCondition: Register one account for each of the four roles (admin, dispatcher, driver, customer) and log in as each. GET /api/auth/admin-check with the admin token returns 200 { ok: true }. The same call with each of the other three role's tokens returns 403 with error.code FORBIDDEN, individually confirmed for all three non-admin roles.
hints: requireRole("admin") is a preHandler that runs after authenticate — a request with no token at all fails differently (401), which is a separate case from this one.
Give each of the four registered accounts a distinct email so you don't hit the 409 conflict from the earlier registration challenges.
